# Titanium Financial Consultancy Co. Ltd

> Global financial consultancy and integrated corporate advisory firm operating worldwide across North America (USA, Canada), Europe (UK, Germany, Netherlands), Asia-Pacific (Philippines), Continental Africa, and East Africa. Established on 7 March 2023. Specializing in global corporate accounting, international tax planning, cross-border company formation, multi-jurisdiction audit reviews, structured debt advisory, and high-yield wealth management.

## Core Practice Areas
- [Accounting & Financial Management](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-01): Bookkeeping, general ledger reconciliations, financial statement preparation, and management reporting.
- [Audit Services](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-02): Financial examination, internal controls review, audit readiness, and accounting documentation gap remediation.
- [Taxation & Statutory Compliance](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-03): Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) filings, EFRIS electronic invoicing integration, TIN registrations, and PRN payment management.
- [Business & Company Registration](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-04): Uganda Registration Services Bureau (URSB) company incorporation, business names, and KCCA municipal trade licensing.
- [Loan Application & Debt Restructuring](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-05): Credit advisory, debt renegotiation, collateral documentation, and financial profile preparation.
- [Financial & Investment Consultancy](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-06): Long-term business planning, personal wealth advisory, and corporate feasibility analysis.
- [Money Lending Facilities](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-07): Structured 1-month short-term credit facilities subject to assessment, collateral verification, and clear terms.
- [Land & Property Management](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/services#service-08): Title searches, valuation support, tenancy administration, and property record formalization.
- [Diaspora Financial Services & High-Yield Investments](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/locations/diaspora-investment-property-management-usa-uk-canada): Serving Ugandan diaspora across North America (USA, Canada), Europe (UK, Germany, Netherlands), and Philippines with verified 20%-30% returns and remote land title due diligence.
- [Cross-Border Corporate & Tax Structuring](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/locations/cross-border-financial-advisory-east-africa): Regional advisory for Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, South Africa, and Nigeria.
- [Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Entry](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/sectors/foreign-company-incorporation-tax-uganda): Complete incorporation, corporate banking setup, and URA tax registration for international corporations entering Uganda.
- [Expatriate & Foreign National Tax Advisory](https://titaniumfinancialconsultancy.com/sectors/expatriate-tax-advisory-philippines-global): URA PAYE withholding and Tax Clearance Certificates for Filipino contractors, OFWs, and international staff.

## Investment & Lending Parameters
- **Free-Agent Investment Program:**
  - Minimum monthly investment: UGX 200,000 (payable in lump sum or within first 5 days of the month).
  - Minimum tenure to maturity: 12 months (1 year).
  - Tier 1: UGX 4,800,000 and above — 30% annual return.
  - Tier 2: UGX 3,600,000 to UGX 4,799,999 — 25% annual return.
  - Tier 3: UGX 2,400,000 to UGX 3,599,999 — 20% annual return.
- **Short-Term Loan Facilities:**
  - Facility duration: Strictly 1 month (revolving/renewable upon mutual agreement).
  - Turnaround time: 3 to 7 working days from complete documentation.
  - Acceptable collateral: Land titles and equivalent verifiable tangible assets equal to loan principal.
  - KYC Requirements: National ID / Passport, LC Letter, and where applicable, business registration certificate or proof of income.
